inspection_scope: Complete supplied film plan reviewed as data: one five-word proposition, one rhetorical chapter, one setup, and one beat. Assessment covers rhetorical progression, narration coverage, setup boundaries, semantic center, metaphor persistence, token lifecycle, composition diversity, and planned hierarchy.

checks.evidence: Setup s1 uses one coherent burden/accumulation rule: requests are represented by receipts, and their increasing mass lowers one scale tray. No unrelated physical system or evidence class enters the setup.

The twenty receipts intentionally accumulate to express rising cost. The before/after contract changes from an empty level tray to the same tray lowered by the receipt load; no obsolete mechanism is retained.
The receipts are repeated members of one cost group, organized around the receipt scale. The nearby spring is a local causal reaction of that same load rather than an unrelated dominant group.
The plan contains only one proposition and one setup, so there is no sequence of unrelated propositions repeating the same framing. The subject framing serves the single accumulating-load rule.
No cross-setup continuity tokens are planned. Receipts persist only inside s1 as the meaningful accumulated burden and terminate with the film.

The paper backboard and work surface establish the physical set; the corner crop directs attention toward contact; and the spring communicates local recoil. No purposeless decorative geometry is specified.
There is no semantic shift requiring an internal reset. Setup s1 develops one rule through the entire narration and ends immediately after its visible consequence.

The planned dominant region is one broad scale tray, with all receipt movement directed into its increasing load. Bot participation and local spring recoil support that action rather than introducing separate hero actions.
The central action independently conveys the claim: repeated receipts visibly burden and lower the same tray from its level before-state. The meaning does not depend on narration or captions alone.

setup_assessments.evidence: The setup covers the entire narration in order and maintains one semantic center, one burden/accumulation rule, one hero, and one causal before/after transformation. Its persistence and end reset are structurally justified.

limits: This data-only review assesses planned structure and hierarchy, not execution. It cannot establish rendered clarity, actual 360×640 mobile-glance performance, pixel visibility, animation timing, occlusion, caption readability, or listening/audio performance.
